value.rationale: Ordered gaps quantify scale-specific components of a random partition while Q measures global quadratic concentration. The theorem determines every rankwise covariance sign, gives exact formulas and a nontrivial universal asymptotic dividing proportion exp(-2), not derivable solely from marginal moments. This is a motivated dependence phase diagram of classic spacing statistics, not an arbitrary finite calculation.
